# Lumberjack

[All quest chapters](index.md)

<a id="q-4378045879b7928b"></a>

## Become a Lumberjack

The Treasure Tree Adam grows so strong that only a handful of ships in history were ever built from it.

Choose Lumberjack as one of your professions.

**Tasks**

- Choose Lumberjack

**Rewards**

- Doriki +60, Belly +2,000, Lumberjack XP +300

<a id="q-7c974bef18ecbc46"></a>

## Apprentice Lumberjack

Timber, then more timber.

Reach Lumberjack level 5.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Become a Lumberjack](lumberjack.md#q-4378045879b7928b)

**Tasks**

- Reach Lumberjack level 5

**Rewards**

- Doriki +120, Belly +6,000, Lumberjack XP +800

<a id="q-37b65d7bf90a8292"></a>

## Journeyman Lumberjack

Water 7's shipwrights always need wood. Hold a log of the Kuuigosu and of the Burning Tree, and deliver sixty-four logs to the docks.

Reach Lumberjack level 25, Hold the rare logs, Land on a shipwrights' town in Paradise and deliver 64 oak logs.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Apprentice Lumberjack](lumberjack.md#q-7c974bef18ecbc46)

**Tasks**

- Reach Lumberjack level 25
- Hold the rare logs
- Land on a shipwrights' town in Paradise
- Deliver 64 oak logs

**Rewards**

- Doriki +240, Belly +25,000, Lumberjack XP +3,000

<a id="q-65e2b04f0971dc15"></a>

## Expert Lumberjack

Fell the Treasure Tree Adam. The giants of Elbaph know that tree better than anyone.

Reach Lumberjack level 50, Fell the Treasure Tree Adam and land on a wild island in the New World.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Journeyman Lumberjack](lumberjack.md#q-37b65d7bf90a8292)

**Tasks**

- Reach Lumberjack level 50
- Fell the Treasure Tree Adam
- Land on a wild island in the New World

**Rewards**

- Doriki +480, Belly +70,000, Lumberjack XP +7,000, New World Crate

<a id="q-306f7ccec78adeb7"></a>

## Master Lumberjack

Only one feller of the Adam tree is remembered at a time.

Reach Lumberjack level 100 and earn the title.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Expert Lumberjack](lumberjack.md#q-65e2b04f0971dc15)

**Tasks**

- Reach Lumberjack level 100

**Rewards**

- Doriki +900, Belly +250,000, Legendary Crate
